newsitem.title: JAPAN: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF GIANT SLALOM WINNER VON GRUENIGEN.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF GIANT SLALOM WINNER VON GRUENIGEN.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of a men's World Cup giant slalom on Saturday:

World Cup wins: 10. All giant slaloms - Veysonnaz (93), Val d'Isere (94), Tignes (95), Vail (95), Park City (95), Adelboden (96), Hinterstoder (96), Alta Badia (96), Kranjska Gora (97), Shiga Kogen (97).

Other feats: Has won World Cup giant slalom overall title for two consecutive years. Reigning world champion in giant slalom. Won bronze medals in slalom and giant slalom at last year's world championships. Finished seventh in slalom at 1992 Albertville Olympics. Finished third overall in last year's World Cup.
